description:
Some of the most interesting ideas often come from the most unexpected places. We searched the globe for ideas with the power to inspire, motivate and change lives — and we found them at TEDx events around the world. On “The TED Idea Search,” we’ll take you on a behind-the-scenes journey following extraordinary speakers from 9 different countries competing for the chance to take the TED main stage in Vancouver this April.

Who will get that chance? Find out on March 3

author: TED
description:
Can you measure a "good life?" Management consultant Chris Musser set out to answer this question for himself, developing a daily tracker to monitor progress across nine dimensions, from faith and relationships to work and wellbeing. Learn how it helped him focus on what really matters — and how you can adopt this 90-second habit, too. (Recorded at TED@BCG on October 23, 2025)
